name: TOOL CADDY
description: The Tool Caddy is the perfect accessory for workers who fill their finishing boxes with a compound tube instead of a loading pump. The durable design and construction of the Tool Caddy securely holds any size finishing box in the perfect filling position, even with the handle attached. It conveniently holds any length compound tube and filler adapter, preventing the need to place the tool on the floor or in the bucket of joint compound between fills. The position of the Tool Caddy’s support bracket can be adjusted to securely attach to almost any bucket height and is perfect to rest your finishing boxes even when using a loading pump. The Tool Caddy positions the finishing box securely, preventing the tool from falling or joint compound from leaking.
